theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cc_density_representation
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), 1 ≤ n → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Set.indicator R.carrier (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ≥0∞)) x))) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), 1 ≤ n → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure K ≠ ∞) → R.measure = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ((limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
